detailed_description: Title Capitalization Tool converts headlines, page titles, email subjects, and document headings to title case, sentence case, uppercase, or lowercase. The title-case mode keeps common small words such as a, an, and, of, the, and to lowercase unless they appear at the start, end, or after a punctuation break.
usage_steps: Paste the title, headline, or subject line into the text area.
Choose Title Case, Sentence case, UPPERCASE, or lowercase.
Review the converted title plus word and character counts.
Copy the output and switch styles when you need another capitalization format.
usage_examples: Convert a blog headline to title case before publishing.
Change an email subject line to sentence case for a calmer campaign tone.
Normalize a batch of page titles to uppercase or lowercase while reviewing metadata.

faqs.question: Is Title Capitalization Tool free?
faqs.answer: Yes. The tool is free to use in your browser and does not require an account.

faqs.question: Does the tool upload my inputs?
faqs.answer: No. The capitalization conversion runs locally in your browser.

faqs.question: Does Title Capitalization Tool use an AI API?
faqs.answer: No. This tool uses local templates and formatting logic in your browser; it does not call an AI model.

faqs.question: Which words stay lowercase in title case?
faqs.answer: Common small words such as a, an, and, as, at, by, for, in, of, on, the, to, and via stay lowercase unless they are at an edge or after punctuation.
